redfin.remarks: Welcome to this exceptional top-floor residence at San Tropez Villas, ideally located in the heart of Studio City just moments from Ventura Boulevard. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath condominium offers approximately 1,417 square feet of light-filled living space with soaring ceilings, an open and inviting floor plan, and a versatile loft that can be used as a home office, den, creative space, or additional lounge area with a huge rooftop patio with great views. Both bedrooms feature en-suite bathrooms, a powder room in the hall for guests, while the living room offers a cozy fireplace and direct access to one of the home's multiple outdoor spaces. The primary suite provides its own private retreat, and in-unit laundry adds everyday convenience. Enjoy the privacy and serenity of a top-floor location with peaceful neighborhood and treetop views from multiple windows and outdoor areas. The gated community features a sparkling pool and fitness center, and the unit includes two assigned parking spaces plus private storage. Perfectly positioned near Ventura Boulevard's renowned restaurants, cafes, shopping and entertainment, as well as the LA River and nearby walking and recreational trails, this unique residence offers the best of Studio City living in a quiet, tucked-away setting.
